\begin{array}{ccc} CH_3COOH + C_2H_5OH & \xrightleftharpoons{H_2SO_4, t^\circ} & CH_3COOC_2H_5 + H_2O \\ 0.1\text{mol} & 0.2\text{mol} & 0.05\text{mol} \\ 0.1\text{mol} & \longrightarrow & 0.1\text{mol} \end{array}
H = \frac{0.05}{0.1} \times 100\% = 50\%
